lines.text: Jehoram son of Ahab becomes king of Israel, removes the pillar of Baal, but clings to the sins of Jeroboam.
Mesha king of Moab rebels after Ahab dies, so Jehoram asks Jehoshaphat of Judah to fight Moab with him.
After a roundabout seven days through the Desert of Edom, the kings have no water and go down to Elisha.
Elisha agrees to help for the sake of Jehoshaphat, and a harpist plays, and he says the valley will fill with water after heavy rain.

wrong_details.wrong: the valley will fill with water after heavy rain
wrong_details.true: they will not see wind or rain, but the valley will be filled with water

lines.text: Water looks like blood to the Moabites, Israel strikes them down, and after the king of Moab offers his son, Israel captures Kir-haraseth.

wrong_details.true: there was great fury against the Israelites, so they withdrew and returned to their own land
